name: deltao_all
mod: process.hgcalLayerClustersEE.plugin.deltao = [VALUE, VALUE, VALUE, VALUE]; process.hgcalLayerClustersHSi.plugin.deltao = [VALUE, VALUE, VALUE, VALUE]; process.hgcalLayerClustersHSci.plugin.deltao = [VALUE/2.6*0.063, VALUE/2.6*0.063, VALUE/2.6*0.063, VALUE/2.6*0.063]
info: Outlier distance (delta_o) in all parts together (EE, HSi, HSci; HFNose ignored). VALUE is applied directly in silicon units (EE, HSi); HSci is rescaled by its default ratio to silicon (0.063/2.6). Default value is 2.6 (0.063 for HSci).
